spec.question: What coarse spatial dynamics and intermediate spectral dimension does the declared finite seam-averaging observer history support?
spec.source_family: oph_exact.federation.build_federation(level, 'port_pair'); same canonical twelve-port carrier and production gluing as settlement runs
spec.eigensolver: symmetric dense eigh only for level0; sparse shift-invert eigsh at shift -1e-6 otherwise; residual and orthogonality recorded, no eigenvalue relabeling on failure
spec.diffusion_time_units: sweeps; Poissonized seam attempts at rate number_of_seams give exact mean semigroup exp(-t L/2)
spec.heat_time_rule: 121 logarithmic times from 0.01/lambda2 to 10/lambda2; exact known-mode heat trace plus deterministic tail bound (ports-known_modes)exp(-t lambda_last/2)
spec.spectral_dimension_window: reported only where truncation tail bound/known trace <=0.001 and t lambda2/2 lies between0.03 and0.3; no posthoc window selection
spec.mode_bands: sphere ordering: ell1 indices1..3, ell2 indices4..8, ell3 indices9..15; report means and splitting; these are diagnostics, not assumed degeneracies
spec.carrier_elimination: constant-per-carrier trial coordinate fields compared with true lowest modes; dense static Schur complement at level0 only, exact block algebra residual checked
spec.history_falsifier: positive monotone global time changes retain positive real relaxation factors; a wave control on same Laplacian has oscillatory cosine factors and requires additional velocity state
controls: unconnected carrier has20 independent zero modes at level0
cycle graph256 spectral dimension near1 in its diffusion window
flat square torus32x32 spectral dimension near2
flat cubic torus12x12x12 spectral dimension near3
conservative wave on actual first positive mode crosses zero while diffusion under monotone clock does not
spec.stopping: bounded levels0..4, one process, BLAS1; any eigensolver failure is retained as failure; no larger levels, no tuning toward dimension2
spec.resource: local small arrays only, no persisted artifact>100MB; if needed existing AWS host nice10 oneprocess only, no cloud launch
nonclaims: no cosmological clock or scale identification
no proof of a refinement limit
no assertion that all OPH constructions share this dissipative mean law
clock no-go covers positive scalar reparameterization of this mean semigroup, not arbitrary state-dependent clock conditioning
spectral dimension refers to screen transport, not dimension of physical bulk spacetime

static_schur.scope: Static elimination at level0; frequency-dependent memory and refinement limit not inferred.
